reduction: one context-bound obligation per baseline-or-single-domain-loss and requested zone
selection: one shared selection across all obligations; unit cost per selected sensor
failureSemantics: each declared domain independently; its complete member set is removed simultaneously
inputBinding: every domain kind, label and member
solverBudget: existing CoverBudget applies to the expanded solver; reduction construction is separately structurally bounded
certificate: resolve each element through ResilientCoverProblem::obligation; the failed domain and zone are explicit
operatorIntegration: fss-cover select-resilient uses one whole-window source; fss-cover select remains nominal selection
modelCheck: scripts/resilient_cover_model_check.py; independent finite model, not Rust execution
